versions.changelog:
Initial release of the brawl-stars skill.

- Registers the “荒野乱斗 (Brawl Stars)” skill for organizing public game info, event guides, esports details, and community rules.
- Provides guidelines and boundaries: only handles public info, no account trading, cheating, recharge bypass, or private data.
- Lists main entry points for game homepage, events, announcements, and support.
- Outlines common tasks such as summarizing updates, extracting event and rules information, and compiling penalties and safety info.
- Details supported data fields and automation tips to keep outputs up to date and compliant.
- Includes example workflows for event aggregation, version change summaries, and rule collections.
- Reinforces compliance and data privacy requirements.
